# Brandt-Daroff — BPPV Home Treatment App

> URL: https://alcoceba.github.io/brandt-daroff/
> Full documentation for LLMs: https://alcoceba.github.io/brandt-daroff/llms-full.txt
> Repository: https://github.com/alcoceba/brandt-daroff

A free, privacy-first, offline Progressive Web App (PWA) that guides patients through Brandt-Daroff vestibular rehabilitation exercises for BPPV (benign paroxysmal positional vertigo / VPPB) at home.

## Target audience

Patients diagnosed with BPPV by an ENT specialist, neurologist, or healthcare provider who have been instructed to perform home vestibular habituation exercises. This application is a clinical timer and tracking aid, not a diagnostic or prescribing tool.

## Clinical safety warning

The application includes persistent safety warnings. Patients must stop exercises immediately and seek prompt medical evaluation if they experience:
- Sudden weakness in a face or limb
- Numbness or loss of sensation in an arm or leg
- Vision changes (double vision, partial vision loss)
- Severe speech difficulty or confusion

## What it does

- Guided step-by-step timer for each exercise position (Sitting -> Lying right 45° -> Rest -> Lying left 45° -> Long rest)
- Visual countdown ring and clear position illustrations
- Protocol tracking: default 14-day schedule, 3 sessions/day, 5 cycles/session
- Extra sessions: tracked separately without inflating scheduled protocol progress
- Two operating modes: Full Treatment Progress tracking and Quick Timer (no tracking)
- Sound (Web Audio API) and vibration (navigator.vibrate) cues for position transitions
- Early advance option ("Dizziness has passed -> Next") when vertigo subsides before 30s
- Emergency stop and pause controls always reachable
- Multilingual interface: English, Catalan (Català), Spanish (Castellano)

## Architecture

- React 19 + Vite + TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS with high contrast, mobile-first design (>=56px tap targets)
- Zustand + localStorage for client-side persistence (zero backend, zero analytics trackers by default, no personal health data leaves the device)
- react-i18next with type-safe dictionaries
- Service worker via vite-plugin-pwa for complete offline functionality
- Ready for mobile bundling via Capacitor (Android/iOS)
